headline: Warden Counterattacks Reclaim Northern Fronts as Marban Hollow Flares
war_summary: Warden counter-strokes have reversed recent Colonial inroads across the northern theatre since the last edition. In Kuura Strand, Warden forces recaptured lost ground to re-establish total control over all six strategic bases, while the Colonial lodgment at Blackthroat in Viper Pit was swiftly repelled to restore an eight-base Warden sweep. Nevish Line saw Warden arms rally from their earlier setback, pushing back to a 6–2 advantage amidst forty-seven base transitions recorded over the past day. To the east, Marban Hollow abruptly flared into action, logging five rapid transitions that reduced one strongpoint to no-man's-land while casualties accelerated sharply on both sides. Contested actions remain intensely fluid across Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf, where garrisons continue to trade hands under heavy attrition. Farther north, Palantine Berm has rekindled with fresh base skirmishes, while the grinding engagements in Callahan's Passage and Mooring County persist unabated, each devouring upwards of fifteen hundred casualties in two hours without altering regional ownership lines.
